sloka: अनेन स परामृष्टो राम सूर्यरथोपरि ।अपक्रान्तस्ततस्त्रस्तो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः ।। ७.३५.३२ ॥
transliteration: anena sa parāmṛṣṭo rāma sūryarathopari ।apakrāntastatastrasto rāhuścandrārkamardanaḥ ।। 7.35.32 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, when he (the original Rahu), the tormentor of the moon and sun, was touched by that other one upon the sun's chariot, he became frightened and departed from there.
